entries.name: Alert
entries.description: A permanent edge of wariness — the sense that lets you react before trouble even announces itself.

fieldValues.effect: +5 to initiative; can't be surprised while conscious; attackers you can't see don't get advantage against you from that alone.

entries.name: Athlete
entries.description: Years of conditioning make the body's basic feats of strength and agility second nature.

fieldValues.effect: Climbing no longer costs extra movement; standing up from prone costs only 5 ft; +1 STR or DEX.

entries.name: Actor
entries.description: A gift for becoming someone else entirely, voice and mannerisms included.

fieldValues.effect: +1 CHA; advantage on Deception/Performance checks to pass as another person; can mimic another person's speech or a creature's sounds you've heard.

entries.name: Crossbow Expert
entries.description: Extensive practice with crossbows lets you get far more out of them than most.

fieldValues.effect: Ignore the loading property of crossbows; no disadvantage on ranged attacks while a hostile creature is within 5 ft; bonus-action shot with a hand crossbow after an attack with a one-handed weapon.

entries.name: Dual Wielder
entries.description: Fighting with a blade in each hand, fluidly, is a discipline of its own.

fieldValues.effect: +1 AC while wielding two melee weapons; can two-weapon fight even with weapons that aren't Light; can draw or stow two one-handed weapons at once.

entries.name: Durable
entries.description: A body that simply refuses to go down easily.

fieldValues.effect: +1 CON; when you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points, the result can't be lower than twice your Constitution modifier.

entries.name: Great Weapon Master
entries.description: Brute, controlled power — the kind that ends fights in one or two swings.

fieldValues.effect: Bonus-action melee attack when you score a critical hit or reduce a creature to 0 HP; may take -5 to hit for +10 damage with a heavy weapon.

entries.name: Healer
entries.description: A practical, hands-on knack for keeping people alive in the field.

fieldValues.effect: Using a healer's kit to stabilize a creature also restores 1 HP; spending a use of the kit to tend a wound restores additional HP based on the target's hit dice.

entries.name: Heavy Armor Master
entries.description: Armor this heavy stops being a burden and starts being a wall.

fieldValues.effect: +1 STR; while wearing heavy armor, reduce non-magical bludgeoning/piercing/slashing damage taken by 3.

entries.name: Inspiring Leader
entries.description: Some people just know how to put heart back into a tired party.

fieldValues.effect: Spend 10 minutes giving an inspiring speech; up to six allies who hear it each gain temporary hit points.

entries.name: Lucky
entries.description: An uncanny knack for things breaking your way at exactly the right moment.

fieldValues.effect: Gain 3 luck points per long rest; spend one to give yourself advantage on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, or to impose disadvantage on an attack roll against you.

entries.name: Mobile
entries.description: Quick, light-footed, and hard to pin down.

fieldValues.effect: +10 ft speed; difficult terrain doesn't cost extra movement when you Dash; no opportunity attacks from a creature you've just attacked in melee.

entries.name: Resilient
entries.description: A focused effort to shore up your one weak spot.

fieldValues.effect: +1 to an ability score of your choice; gain proficiency in saving throws using that ability.

entries.name: Sentinel
entries.description: You don't just punish creatures for leaving — you make it very hard for them to try.

fieldValues.effect: Creatures provoking an opportunity attack from you have their speed reduced to 0 for the turn; you can make an opportunity attack when a creature within reach attacks someone other than you.

entries.name: Sharpshooter
entries.description: A shooter who's stopped needing the target to be an easy one.

fieldValues.effect: Ranged attacks ignore half and three-quarters cover; no disadvantage at long range; may take -5 to hit for +10 damage with a ranged weapon.

entries.name: Skilled
entries.description: Broad, practical competence rather than any one specialty.

fieldValues.effect: Gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools.

entries.name: Tavern Brawler
entries.description: Whatever's within reach — a chair, a bottle, a fist — becomes a weapon in your hands.

fieldValues.effect: +1 STR or CON; proficient with improvised weapons and unarmed strikes (which deal 1d4); hitting with an unarmed strike lets you attempt to grapple as a bonus action.

entries.name: Tough
entries.description: Some people are just built to take a beating and keep going.

fieldValues.effect: Max HP increases by 2 per character level (retroactively, and again each time you level up).

entries.name: War Caster
entries.description: Spellcasting that holds up even in the middle of a brawl.

fieldValues.prerequisite: The ability to cast at least one spell
fieldValues.effect: Advantage on concentration saves; can perform somatic components with weapons/shield in hand; can cast a spell as an opportunity attack instead of a melee attack.

entries.name: Keen Mind
entries.description: A mind that files everything away and never quite loses the thread.

fieldValues.effect: +1 INT; always know which way is north, how many hours until sunrise/sunset, and can accurately recall anything seen or heard within the last month.
